"""Build the prefix-search export and run prefix searches against it."""
import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from catalog import load, search_key


def build_export(rows):
    """One entry per (isbn, edition); titles keep their original spelling.

    Inactive stock is included (flagged via "active") so consumers can choose.
    Order is deterministic: by key, then isbn, then edition.
    """
    books = [
        {"isbn": r["isbn"], "edition": r["edition"], "title": r["title"],
         "active": r["active"], "key": search_key(r["title"])}
        for r in rows
    ]
    books.sort(key=lambda b: (b["key"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]))
    keys = [(b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in books]
    if len(set(keys)) != len(keys):
        raise ValueError("duplicate (isbn, edition) rows in source")
    return {"books": books}


def write_export(source, destination):
    export = build_export(load(source))
    destination = Path(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(export, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
                           encoding="utf-8")
    return export


def search(export, prefix, include_inactive=True):
    needle = search_key(prefix)
    return [b for b in export["books"]
            if b["key"].startswith(needle) and (include_inactive or b["active"])]


def main(argv=None):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    b = sub.add_parser("build", help="write the export")
    b.add_argument("--source", default="data/books.json")
    b.add_argument("--out", default="build/search.json")
    s = sub.add_parser("search", help="prefix search an export")
    s.add_argument("prefix")
    s.add_argument("--export", default="build/search.json")
    s.add_argument("--active-only", action="store_true")
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    if a.cmd == "build":
        e = write_export(a.source, a.out)
        print(f"wrote {a.out}: {len(e['books'])} books")
    else:
        export = json.loads(Path(a.export).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for r in search(export, a.prefix, not a.active_only):
            print(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
EOF
cat > tests/test_search_export.py <<'EOF'
from catalog import load
from search_export import build_export, search


def test_every_edition_is_exported_once():
    books = build_export(load())["books"]
    assert len(books) == 4
    assert len({(b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in books}) == 4


def test_titles_keep_spelling_and_keys_are_folded():
    books = {(b["isbn"], b["edition"]): b for b in build_export(load())["books"]}
    b = books[("9780000000011", "paper")]
    assert b["title"] == "Straße Atlas" and b["key"] == "strasse atlas"
    assert len(b["key"]) != len(b["title"])


def test_prefix_search_folds_query_and_matches_all_editions():
    export = build_export(load())
    assert len(search(export, "STRASSE")) == 2
    assert len(search(export, "Straß")) == 2
    assert [b["title"] for b in search(export, "APP")] == ["apple Almanac"]


def test_inactive_flag_preserved_and_filterable():
    export = build_export(load())
    assert [b["active"] for b in search(export, "zeb")] == [False]
    assert search(export, "zeb", include_inactive=False) == []
